meta.name: rollback
meta.description: Prepare and rehearse a recovery path for an intended release. Use when rollback is assumed, untested or previously failed; follow the environment authority for any drill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提前准备并演练回滚方案,让发布故障有退路
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发布都担心出错却从没真正演练过回滚
copy.tagline_en: Prepare and rehearse a rollback plan before you ship a release
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you ship often but have never actually rehearsed a rollback

howto.what: Claude 会先读任务上下文契约与回滚方法文档,再为即将发布的版本准备并演练一条恢复路径;缺失的能力或未执行的检查会如实报告,不会声称装技能就自带了基础设施。
howto.when: 当回滚只是被假定、未经验证,或此前失败过时接管;任何演练都听环境权限方的安排。若由 @fde 调用,则复用其现有的脱敏数据包与范围。

say.text: 帮我为这次发布准备一条回滚路径。
say.note: 会先读方法文档再设计恢复步骤。

say.text: 这次回滚之前失败过,带我演练一遍。
say.note: 演练按环境权限方的规定进行。

say.text: 按 @fde 当前的脱敏数据包继续,别重新开始。
say.note: 复用已有上下文与范围,不重启初始化。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and the rollback method, then prepares and rehearses a recovery path for an intended release, reporting missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when rollback is assumed, untested or previously failed; any drill follows the environment authority. If called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope.

say_en.text: Help me prepare a rollback path for this release.
say_en.note: It reads the method, then designs recovery steps.

say_en.text: Rollback failed before — walk me through a drill.
say_en.note: The drill follows the environment authority.

say_en.text: Continue from @fde's current sanitized packet; don't restart.
